about: The fixed vocabulary for the heuristic library (issue #128). Every heuristic's kind and tags, and every product page's features and fact kinds, must come from here; trailhound/tests/test_heuristic_library.py checks it. A heuristic with no surface tag applies to every surface.

kinds.attack: a specific way to try to make the product fail
kinds.oracle: a way to recognise a problem when you see one
kinds.quality_criterion: a kind of quality to look at
kinds.product_model: a part of the product to look at

fact_kinds.claimed: anything the product claims, wherever it says it: a spec or help text, the product's own pages and messages, marketing, emails to customers, promises
fact_kinds.shown: seen in the product itself: a value, a label, a screen
fact_kinds.rule: a business rule the product is meant to follow
fact_kinds.standard: a law, regulation or standard the product must meet
